open.title: Improve the goal tracker on the website
open.description: I'd like to improve the goal tracker feature on sthopwood.com. Since I can't inspect the current code directly, I'm submitting this as an improvement idea to be reviewed and implemented. The goal tracker should be enhanced to be more useful and user-friendly.
open.steps: 1. Review the current goal tracker implementation in the codebase. 2. Identify key pain points and missing features. 3. Propose concrete improvements (e.g., progress bars, due dates, priority levels, categories, recurring goals, reminders, completion history/streaks). 4. Implement the improvements with minimal, clean code changes. 5. Test the updated goal tracker and verify it works correctly.
open.expected: A more capable, user-friendly goal tracker that helps users set, track, and complete their goals effectively.
open.actual: The current goal tracker exists but could be improved in terms of functionality and usability.

open.title: Add improvement idea to bug report
open.description: This is an improvement idea for the bug report / support workflow on sthopwood.com. The goal is to enhance the bug report submission experience by allowing users to attach improvement ideas directly to a bug report, or to link related improvement ideas to an existing bug report.
open.steps: 1. Add a field in the bug report form that lets users optionally attach or link an improvement idea to the report. 2. Allow linking an existing improvement idea to a bug report so related items stay connected. 3. Display linked improvement ideas on the bug report detail view.
open.expected: Users can attach or link improvement ideas to bug reports, keeping related items connected and improving traceability.
open.actual: Currently bug reports and improvement ideas are handled separately with no way to link them together.
